scene.name: Tocker's Trials stage 1-8 combat
scene.scope: authenticated historical render-load proxy; it does not reproduce the user's late-player-combat report

methodology.aggregation: exclusive simpleperf overhead rows by command, symbol, and mutually exclusive symbol category
caveats: each configuration has one semantically gated stage-1-8 profile, so percentage comparisons are diagnostic rather than a promotion experiment
the Shipping libUnreal.so is stripped; unidentified Unreal offsets cannot be assigned to a subsystem
percentages are per-report sample shares, not elapsed milliseconds, and rounded rows can sum slightly above 100 percent

interpretation.high_confidence: RHI submission and guest-host transport are material sampled CPU costs in the heavy proxy; the control attributes 31.49 percent to RHIThread and 16.44 percent to transport symbols.
interpretation.rejected_mechanism: inline submission increased RHI and transport sample shares while regressing FPS and tail latency.
interpretation.not_promoted: the isolated 32 KiB profile was faster in this one stage-1-8 capture but did not reduce transport sample share and had already failed the broader 1-5/1-8 promotion screen; 16 KiB remains selected.
interpretation.late_pvp_next_step: repeat the paired guest/host profile during the same late PvP combat after user authentication is restored.
